description: This source file defines a Razor Pages model class 'ErrorModel' for handling error page requests in an ASP.NET Core web application. It manages the request ID information for display on error pages.

classes.name: ErrorModel
classes.description: A Razor Pages page model for error handling that captures and displays request identifier information.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the error page by setting the RequestId property with the current activity ID or trace identifier.
